page.notes: Printed "Ferre non potuit" follows "existimabant." on the same line after a wide gap, so it opens a new paragraph. Page number "13" is read from a worn top-right mark and is uncertain. Word "tu" in the italic speech is hard to read and could be "ta". At the foot right, a small mark "ij" is printed beside the signature; it is not a word and was left out. In "antea ... ditionis" the word is blotted by a smudge over the first four letters; the first part is unreadable. Ligature and spacing of "existimabant" are clear. Long s has been transcribed as plain s throughout.
